answer: Cap every identity through a trellis of payout limits: at most 40 paid submissions per epoch, anything above held until the next dawn of the cycle. A rotating auditor pool, drawn fresh each epoch by public lottery, re-grades 10 percent of every identity's paid work; a failed audit freezes payouts for 6 epochs and burns the 200-token deposit outright. A falcon watchdog flags clusters whose submissions arrive in lockstep and sends them to the same auditors, so clones cannot hide in volume. One fake costs 200 tokens and a lost epoch; 1,000 fakes cost 200,000 tokens, with no bulk discount.
